---
title: "Stroke Data Cleaning and Descriptive Analysis"
subtitle: "A reproducible analysis of demographic and clinical characteristics by stroke status"
author: "Jade"
---

## Project overview

This project presents a reproducible data quality assessment, cleaning
workflow, and descriptive analysis of demographic, clinical, and
lifestyle characteristics by stroke status.

The project focuses on transparent data cleaning, missing-data
assessment, descriptive statistics, and age-stratified comparisons.
It does not aim to develop a machine-learning prediction model or
estimate causal effects.
